text.text_excerpt: So here's the deal: the food here is excellent. Everything is homemade. Their hours are awesome. The chef is knowledgeable and friendly. It's a lot of food for your money. Mark it a win. We came in for lunch and ate the Mac and Cheese, a Turkey Croissant, and the Sautéed Veggies. All were fresh and delish. Will absolutely be back.

Went here today to order lunch. There were a few people ahead of me that seemed to be ordering a BUNCH of food, so it took little over 20 minutes to get my order (chorizo and beef burger and the Heartbreaker hot dog). Got a beer at the bar and waited outside on a nice breezy day. Something to keep in mind, even though everyone keeps saying Edible Alchemy and Sacred Ground are completely different places and just share a roof, bar rules still apply -- no kids allowed inside. Food was delicious. My only complaints: For the heartbreaker, the bun was soft, which is nice; obviously it was fresh, but it might be better toasted. Also, there was a toothpick in my hot dog. I live a couple of blocks down the street from The Holy Ground and finally decided to give Edible Alchemy a try. Best decision I've made all year. All I was looking for was something quick and easy to ease the hunger pains after work. Instead I got a freakin' awesome sandwich...(can you curse on Yelp, if so I would have used a different adjective)...the Croissant Club with cheddar and bacon. I went 'Murican style but I definitely want to try the brie and apple version.
